prompts.caption: Instrumental Chinese melodic EDM with an adventurous minor-pentatonic plucked-string hook, airy bamboo-flute responses, a focused buildup and a bright four-on-the-floor drop with wide synth chords, clean sub bass and spacious fantasy ambience.

Instrumental melodic gaming progressive house with a concise rising synth motif, energetic chord movement, crisp electronic drums and a clear arrangement that expands from an atmospheric intro into an uplifting layered final drop.

Instrumental cinematic glitch-hop with a playful syncopated lead motif, short call-and-response phrases, punchy halftime drums, controlled sub bass, orchestral accents and a contrasting breakdown before a denser melodic return.
